title: Caliburn A3 Fixed Coil Replacement Pod 1.0 Ohm 2ml - 4 Pack
description: The Uwell Caliburn A3 pod kit is the latest addition to Uwell’s hugely popular Caliburn series of MTL devices, and is as simple-to-use and as satisfying as ever. As slimline and easy to pocket as its predecessors, the Caliburn A3 is the perfect device for vapers who require a simple, lightweight and convenient vape kit that doesn’t sacrifice on flavour. The Caliburn A3 introduces the new A3 pods, which feature a 2ml e-liquid capacity. The Uwell Caliburn A3 pods can be refilled by removing the cap to reveal the top-fill port in red. The A3 Pods connect to the battery securely, and their integrated 1.0ohm mesh coil, combined with Uwell’s Pro-FOCS flavour adjustment tech, ensures a deliciously flavoursome and satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape. The pods are versatile enough that they can be used with high-PG , 50/50 and nicotine salt e-liquids. When your pod begins to lose its flavour, simply replace the pod, top up with e-liquid and you’re ready to vape. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
